发条恐怪 Clockwork Horror

发条恐怪一种是毫无情感的昆虫型机器人——身覆精金或其他贵金属装甲的骇人机器。它们乘坐着被征服的魔法船漫游荒宇，收集用于建造更多同类所需的贵金属和水晶。发条恐怪除了自我复制之外便没有其他的任何目标，并会不惜一切代价创造新的发条恐怪。假使它拥有必需的材料，制造另一个同类所需的时间大约是十天。
发条恐怪主体直径约两尺，但算上腿部之后它的总直径可以到达四尺。它的额部嵌有一颗让发条恐怪可以视物的水晶。
发条恐怪通过咔哒声、嗡鸣声和其他类似的机械声音相互交流，这些声音完美地模仿了斯里克林语，这也让某些人推测世上第一台发条恐怪是一位螳螂人奇械师的创意。发条恐怪也可以从它的水晶眼睛中发射出光线，向其他能看到光的生物发出点和破折号的信息。除了发条恐怪之外，其他生物也可以学习这种闪烁的光线密码，即光电码（Ziklight）。
当其他生物妨碍了一只发条恐怪时，它会用自己那锋利的下颚和两个安装在前肢尖端的微型旋转电锯攻击那个生物。发条恐怪也通过嵌在其体内的闪电短杆释放闪电束。
当发条恐怪死亡时，创造它的魔法会在1分钟内快速地将它吞噬。它的金属身体和水晶眼睛将迅速分解，最后只剩下一小堆闪闪发光的尘埃。

# Contract Sentinel
Large aberration, chaotic neutral
Armor Class 14 (natural armor)
Hit Points 78 (12d10 + 12)
Speed 10 ft., fly 40 ft.
STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA
17 (+3) 15 (+2) 12 (+1) 13 (+1) 12 (+1) 14 (+2)
Skills Stealth +5
Senses darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11
Languages Deep Speech, Undercommon
Challenge 8 (3,900 XP)

Spellcasting. The sentinel casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
Shared 1/day: Alarm, Blur
Shared 2/day: Invisibility, Mirror Image
At Will: Mage Hand

Actions
Force Pulse (3/Day). Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a DC 16 Strength saving throw. Failure: 10 (3d6) force damage. Success: Half damage. Force Pulse and Soul Mark share these 3 daily uses.
Soul Mark (3/Day). Melee Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. Failure: The target cannot regain hit points until the start of its next turn. Force Pulse and Soul Mark share these 3 daily uses.
Prismatic Gaze (Recharge 5-6). Each creature in a 30-foot cone must make a DC 16 Intelligence or Wisdom saving throw (target's choice). Failure: 7 (2d6) psychic damage. Success: Half damage. On a failed save, the target is moved up to 10 feet to a legal space chosen by the GM.
Spined Strike. Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage. If the target is prone, it takes an extra 7 (2d6) cold damage.

# Contract Sentinel
Large aberration, chaotic neutral
Armor Class 14 (natural armor)
Hit Points 78 (12d10 + 12)
Speed 10 ft., fly 40 ft.
STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA
17 (+3) 15 (+2) 12 (+1) 13 (+1) 12 (+1) 14 (+2)
Skills Stealth +5
Senses darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11
Languages Deep Speech, Undercommon
Challenge 8 (3,900 XP)

Spellcasting. The sentinel casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
Shared 1/day: Alarm, Blur
Shared 2/day: Invisibility, Mirror Image
At Will: Mage Hand

Actions
Force Pulse (3/Day). Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a DC 16 Strength saving throw. Failure: 10 (3d6) force damage. Success: Half damage. Force Pulse and Soul Mark share these 3 daily uses.
Soul Mark (3/Day). Melee Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. Failure: The target cannot regain hit points until the start of its next turn. Force Pulse and Soul Mark share these 3 daily uses.
Prismatic Gaze (Recharge 5-6). Each creature in a 30-foot cone must make a DC 16 Intelligence or Wisdom saving throw (target's choice). Failure: 7 (2d6) psychic damage. Success: Half damage. On a failed save, the target is moved up to 10 feet to a legal space chosen by the GM.
Spined Strike. Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage. If the target is prone, it takes an extra 7 (2d6) cold damage.

# Contract Sentinel
Large aberration, chaotic neutral
Armor Class 14 (natural armor)
Hit Points 78 (12d10 + 12)
Speed 10 ft., fly 40 ft.
STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA
17 (+3) 15 (+2) 12 (+1) 13 (+1) 12 (+1) 14 (+2)
Skills Stealth +5
Senses darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11
Languages Deep Speech, Undercommon
Challenge 8 (3,900 XP)

Spellcasting. The sentinel casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
Shared 1/day: Alarm, Blur
Shared 2/day: Invisibility, Mirror Image
At Will: Mage Hand

Actions
Force Pulse (3/Day). Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a DC 16 Strength saving throw. Failure: 10 (3d6) force damage. Success: Half damage. Force Pulse and Soul Mark share these 3 daily uses.
Soul Mark (3/Day). Melee Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. Failure: The target cannot regain hit points until the start of its next turn. Force Pulse and Soul Mark share these 3 daily uses.
Prismatic Gaze (Recharge 5-6). Each creature in a 30-foot cone must make a DC 16 Intelligence or Wisdom saving throw (target's choice). Failure: 7 (2d6) psychic damage. Success: Half damage. On a failed save, the target is moved up to 10 feet to a legal space chosen by the GM.
Spined Strike. Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage. If the target is prone, it takes an extra 7 (2d6) cold damage.

# Contract Sentinel
Large aberration, chaotic neutral
Armor Class 14 (natural armor)
Hit Points 78 (12d10 + 12)
Speed 10 ft., fly 40 ft.
STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA
17 (+3) 15 (+2) 12 (+1) 13 (+1) 12 (+1) 14 (+2)
Skills Stealth +5
Senses darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11
Languages Deep Speech, Undercommon
Challenge 8 (3,900 XP)

Spellcasting. The sentinel casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
Shared 1/day: Alarm, Blur
Shared 2/day: Invisibility, Mirror Image
At Will: Mage Hand

Actions
Force Pulse (3/Day). Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a DC 16 Strength saving throw. Failure: 10 (3d6) force damage. Success: Half damage. Force Pulse and Soul Mark share these 3 daily uses.
Soul Mark (3/Day). Melee Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. Failure: The target cannot regain hit points until the start of its next turn. Force Pulse and Soul Mark share these 3 daily uses.
Prismatic Gaze (Recharge 5-6). Each creature in a 30-foot cone must make a DC 16 Intelligence or Wisdom saving throw (target's choice). Failure: 7 (2d6) psychic damage. Success: Half damage. On a failed save, the target is moved up to 10 feet to a legal space chosen by the GM.
Spined Strike. Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage. If the target is prone, it takes an extra 7 (2d6) cold damage.
